title: Microsoft presents: Cloud Migration from any SQL

features.name: BC 14 Re-implementation Tool
features.description: A migration tool that enables customers on BC version 14 to migrate directly to BC SaaS without going through intermediate versions. It moves a subset of data and recommends a fresh start for business process standardization.
caveats: Re-implementation only - subset of data moved
Customer starts fresh in SaaS
Requires standardization of business processes

features.name: Cloud Migration Management Page
features.description: A wizard-based interface for configuring and executing the BC re-implementation migration, allowing users to set connection strings, select companies, trigger replication, and monitor progress.

features.name: Replication Progress Tracking
features.description: Capability to track the progress of data replication showing remaining tables and successful tables during the migration process, with visibility into the number of lines replicated for each table.

features.name: Upgrade Progress Tracking
features.description: Tracking of the upgrade progress during migration, addressing what was previously the most reported issue of not being able to monitor upgrade status in real-time.

features.name: Inline Error Fixing
features.description: Ability to fix migration errors inline during the upgrade process without having to restart the entire migration, addressing the all-or-nothing problem of previous tools. Allows company-by-company error resolution.
caveats: Errors need to be fixed in error page before continuing

features.name: Extensible Migration Entities
features.description: 52 migration entities across setup data (40 tables), master data (9 entities), transaction data (1 entity), and historical data (20 entities) that can be extended through extensible enums. Partners can add, replace, or extend any entity.
caveats: Limited to 52 entities currently
May not cover all custom requirements

features.name: Replication Service with Azure Data Factory
features.description: Uses Azure Data Factory replication service to move data from NAV 14 source database to BC SaaS destination database, with support for direct copy when table schemas match and buffer tables for transformed data.
caveats: Requires Azure Data Factory infrastructure
Buffer tables needed for schema differences

features.name: Migrator Interface and Enum Registration
features.description: Extensibility pattern where each migrator implements the BC14Migrator interface and is registered through extensible enums. Allows partners to create custom migrators for setup, master, transaction, and historical data phases.
caveats: Requires AL code knowledge to extend

features.name: Direct Upgrade Path from BC 14 to SaaS
features.description: New capability allowing customers on BC 14 to upgrade directly to the latest BC SaaS version, bypassing the intermediate version requirements that were previously mandatory.
caveats: Only available through re-implementation approach, not traditional upgrade

features.name: BC14 migrator framework with three phases
features.description: Migration framework that runs setup migrators, master migrators, and transaction migrators in sequence using enum-based registry pattern. Each phase is executed through a for loop over the enum, with 40 setup migrators, 9 master migrators, and transaction migrators.
caveats: Requires enum extension implementation
Requires interface implementation

features.name: Entity extension patterns for migration
features.description: Three extension patterns supported: add field to existing entity via table extensions, add new entity via enum extension and codeunit implementation, and add post-migration validation or action. Framework provides 165 extension points.
caveats: Requires understanding of enum and interface implementation
175 extension points may not cover all scenarios

features.name: Migrator hooks for pre and post execution
features.description: Allows subscribers to skip migrators via on_before_run_migrator event or add logging via on_after_run_migrator event. Covers all four migration phases: setup, master, transaction, and historical.
caveats: Limited to skip and logging functionality for custom logic

features.name: Migration plan customization via event subscription
features.description: Allows reordering, removing, or injecting custom migrators into migration phases through on_after_populate_master_migrators event and similar events for other phases. Must set changed flag to apply customizations.
caveats: Requires event subscription pattern
Must set changed flag to true for changes to take effect

features.name: Historical data migration with separate task worker
features.description: Historical data migration runs in separate BC14 historical task worker session rather than main upgrade runner. Improves performance as main upgrade does not wait for historical data completion. Can use data transfer for back volume.
caveats: Separate execution means potential dependency management needed

features.name: Post migration validation and action extension points
features.description: Advanced extension points for post-migration tasks. Post migration action allows custom logic after all data is in, such as posting or recompute. Validation extension allows checking data integrity like balance verification with failures shown on migration error overview.
caveats: For advanced scenarios only

features.name: Custom migration provider interface
features.description: Allows partners to build custom migration tools using custom_migration_provider interface. Implements three-step process: create company table with matching structure, implement custom migration provider interface, extend custom_migration_provider enum.
caveats: Requires SQL script to create company table
Requires matching structure of company table
Must extend enum to appear in selection wizard

features.name: Replication table mappings for data transfer
features.description: Main table mapping configuration for specifying which tables to replicate and how during migration. Used for almost all tables. Works with SQL-based source databases to define table-to-table mapping for replication engine.
caveats: Requires manual configuration of mappings

features.name: Setup table mappings for cloud migration configuration
features.description: Secondary table mapping table identical to replication_table_mappings structure. Used to define setup data that should be replicated immediately when cloud migration is set up, allowing configuration before full data replication. Recommended to keep data small.
caveats: Should keep data small
Only used during initial setup phase

features.name: Record links and notes migration helper tool
features.description: Helper tool to migrate record links and notes from BC14 on-prem. Shipped out of box with version 28 as part of BC implementation. Can be run separately to target specific tables. Provides additional safety by only replicating record links table without affecting other data.
features.status_evidence_quote: We ship this support out of the box with version 28, but the problem is that this works as part of the BC implementation
caveats: Auto-incrementing keys make record links and notes problematic
Separate execution from main implementation recommended

features.name: SQL to SQL replication speed advantage
features.description: Cloud migration tool offers fastest replication speed using SQL-to-SQL approach. Significantly faster than web services-based tools, especially for large tables when database is uploaded to Azure SQL.
caveats: Requires source database in Azure SQL for optimal speed

features.name: Support for difficult-to-move tables via SQL tooling
features.description: Cloud migration tool can move tables that are hard to move through AL code, including tables without incrementing integers, tenant media, and obsoleted tables and fields. Provides alternative to AL-code-based migration.
caveats: May be used as supplementary tool alongside existing tooling

features.name: On-premises development for cloud migration tools
features.description: Enables developers to test cloud migration tools on-premises by configuring the cloud migration management page to look enabled without calling the replication service. Allows quick iteration and debugging with reduced testing time from 45 minutes to 1 hour.
caveats: Uses configuration packages to populate staging tables instead of actual SQL database replication
Requires all hybrid tables and prefixed tables in configuration package

features.name: Custom migration app development framework
features.description: Framework allowing partners to build their own migration apps with table mappings and buffer tables. Supports replicating source tables to multiple destinations and using upgrade code to transform data. Enables full data migration scenarios beyond standard tooling.
caveats: Requires custom app development with table mappings and buffer tables
Partners must maintain compatibility as BC upgrades every 5 releases
Microsoft does not maintain such tools due to supporting 24+ countries in SaaS

features.name: No-code custom migration from any SQL
features.description: Expert feature allowing users to migrate individual tables ad hoc without writing code. Enables selecting and copying specific tables from on-premises SQL sources. Useful for missing tables, performance testing, and populating sandboxes.
caveats: System tables inaccessible by AL code cannot be migrated
Expert feature with warning that it can break database if used incorrectly
Not promoted as standard feature due to complexity

features.name: BC to BC record links and notes migration
features.description: Ability to migrate record links and notes in Business Central to Business Central cloud migrations out of the box without installing helper extensions. Documented with recording available on BC Learn.
caveats: Requires no additional installation

features.name: Cloud migration warnings and validation framework
features.description: New validation framework that shows warnings after cloud migration completes. Alerts users to missing tenant media records and reminds of unmoved record links and notes. Additional warnings can be added if needed.
caveats: Warnings can be added based on partner requests

features.name: Data transfer outside upgrade codeunits
features.description: Enhancement allowing data transfers to be used outside of upgrade codeunits during cloud migration. Enables moving large sets of data wherever needed as long as cloud migration is enabled and intelligent cloud table has enabled field set to true.
caveats: Requires intelligent cloud table enabled field to be set to true

features.name: SQL to SQL copy with AL upgrade
features.description: Partners use SQL copy to transfer data and then trigger AL upgrade code units to handle version upgrades instead of custom code.
caveats: requires manual execution of SQL codes or upgrade code units
not the best approach

features.name: No-code data replication
features.description: Customer no-code replication tool that simply copies data and supports preserving or replacing data in target tables through insert and merge operations.
caveats: must choose between insert/merge or replace mode

features.name: BC 14 implementation tool
features.description: Tool supporting company-by-company data movement but blocks further replication once data transformation starts to ensure data consistency.
caveats: cannot replicate from source after transformation starts
blocks replication to prevent data state uncertainty

features.name: Large table migration performance
features.description: Tool capability for migrating large tables, with noted challenges for extreme sizes like 700 GB in a single table within 24 hours.
caveats: extreme data sizes (700 GB) may face issues
optimization may be possible on case-by-case basis

features.name: BC with upgrade multi-company restriction
features.description: BC with upgrade scenario blocks migrating additional companies to the same tenant after initial migration to prevent table disruption.
caveats: restriction prevents adding more companies after migration started
bc latest to latest migration users assume own responsibility

features.name: BC 14 implementation tool multi-company scenarios
features.description: BC 14 implementation tool allows migrating multiple companies into the same tenant, with user responsibility for data integrity.
caveats: migration of companies into live systems carries risk
not advised without high safety guarantees

features.name: Permission sets and user profiles migration
features.description: Permission sets and user profiles cannot be migrated from BC 14 to SaaS directly; custom AL code is required if needed.
caveats: direct migration not supported
custom AL code extension required

features.name: Extension table data migration
features.description: Extension table data can be migrated using mapping and extensibility examples to handle additional fields through add-field scenarios.
caveats: requires mapping configuration
depends on extensibility pattern usage

features.name: Single-to-multiple-table field mapping
features.description: Tool supports splitting data from a single standard table into multiple extension tables by mapping fields with the same names and structure.
caveats: field-to-field mapping not available
field names must match exactly between source and target

features.name: Data Transfer Objects alternative
features.description: Alternative approach using data transfer objects to replicate all data to SaaS and then transfer through DTOs, available for custom extensions.
caveats: available for custom tables and extensions
not recommended for Microsoft standard tables
